facts: Germany has many navigable rivers, including the Rhine and Elbe.
It shares land borders with nine countries.
Intercity trains connect a dense network of cities.

ko.overview: 독일은 유럽 한가운데 있는 나라로 성, 숲, 강, 과학 기술로 잘 알려져 있어요.
ko.climate: 사계절이 비교적 뚜렷하고, 전반적으로 서늘하거나 온화한 날씨예요.
ko.bestSeason: 늦봄부터 초가을까지 야외 활동하기 좋은 편이에요.
ko.travelTips: 지역 열차와 ICE 고속열차로 많은 도시를 이동할 수 있어요.

overview: Germany sits in central Europe and is known for castles, forests, rivers, science, and engineering.
climate: Germany has four seasons and cool to mild weather in much of the year.
bestSeason: Late spring to early autumn is popular for outdoor travel.
travelTips: Regional trains and long-distance ICE trains connect many cities.
